fingerprintAlgorithm: SHA-256 of the raw bytes of audioInputs concatenated in their listed order
policyConclusions: Recovery bytes require both effective redistribute and offlineCache permission to be allowed. Denied and unverified permissions both preserve metadata as references only.
Exclusion is by exact recording hash, so a permitted-looking custom alias cannot carry omitted bytes for the same restricted recording.
Bundle export, playlist share and backup-set export inherit the shared recovery plan. Missing permitted original bytes still fail; supplied excluded bytes are omitted.
Imported unknown reference markers remain conservative without granting a network source. Trusted catalogue authority is needed to restore approved online playback.
Standalone MP3 export remains governed by redistribution permission; that separate action does not promise an importable offline recovery bundle.
The shared notice accurately covers both denied and unverified offline or redistribution permission. The Music backup panel includes that notice alongside preserved track names.
